q: Who can get DLA for children?
a: Children under 16 who need extra looking after or have walking difficulties because of a health condition or disability, living in England or Wales. Anyone 16 or over applies for PIP instead. Check the rules on GOV.UK.

q: Why compare with a child of the same age?
a: DLA is about the extra care, supervision or mobility help your child needs compared with other children their age. Our questions are built around that.
